definitions.explanation: The act of writing things down, especially taking notes during lectures or meetings.
Used to describe tests or examinations that are written rather than spoken.

notes:
{筆記|ひっき} is writing things down by hand — taking notes as someone speaks, and, in the names of tests, the written format as opposed to the spoken one. It belongs to academic and official contexts; for everyday note-taking speakers reach for ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧ instead.

COMPOUNDS:
- {筆記|ひっき}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (written examination, as against ⟦{口述|こうじゅつ}→口述：09629_koujutsu⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧, an oral one)
- {筆記|ひっき}⟦{用具|ようぐ}→用具：09667_yougu⟧ (writing implements — the standard wording on school and exam instructions)
- {筆記|ひっき}⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (cursive script)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧ - a quick note jotted down for yourself; casual
- ⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧ - a notebook, or the notes kept in one
- ⟦{速記|そっき}→速記：09668_sokki⟧ - shorthand, a specialised kind of {筆記|ひっき}
